title: Give Me Back MC-80476
description: Client mod that restores the old macOS drop-stack shortcut behavior changed in snapshot 25w41a.
body:
Client mod that restores the old macOS drop-stack shortcut behavior changed in snapshot 25w41a. From ctrl+{drop selected item key} back to cmd+{drop selected item key}. Supposedly u have changed drop selected item key from Q to something else and just got too used for this.

On macOS only, the drop-item key once again treats Command (⌘) as the drop-stack modifier. On other operating systems, vanilla behavior. All affected versions since 25w41a are supported.

https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-80476
